newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau-based Nam Kwong Group loan raised to $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Macau-based Nam Kwong Group loan raised to $50 mln.

text.p: China-owned Macau-based Nam Kwong Group Co's term loan facility has been increased to US$50 million from US$30 million, arranger CCIC Finance said.
The facility was oversubscribed to US$62 million but scaled back to US$50 million, it said.
The borrower is 100 percent beneficiary owned by China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.
The five-year loan has an average life of 3.75 years and pays a margin of 87.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 104.83 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$4 million each, are Banque Indosuez and CCIC Finance.
Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$6.5 million each, are Commerz East Asia, Credit Suisse Hong Kong, Hypobank Hong Kong and KEB (Asia) Finance.
Co-lead managers, with US$4 million each, are Banco Exterior de Espana, Credit Agricole Hong Kong, Hanil International Finance and Nippon Credit Bank Hong Kong.
Signing will be held in Hong Kong in early December.
